name: MusicThings: Metronome & Tuner
subtitle: Tap Tempo & Setlist Maker
promo: Find the right pitch, then find your tempo. Tune string by string and go straight back to the beat.
description:
Tune up, then count in. A tuner and a metronome for the same practice session.

• Tune string by string. Choose guitar, bass, ukulele, violin, viola, cello, double bass, banjo, or mandolin. See the string you’re tuning and keep track of the ones you’ve finished.
• Play or sing a note. Chromatic shows the note, octave, and how far it is from the target. Hold the pitch steady to see the green confirmation build.
• Set your tempo with the dial or tap it in. Shape the rhythm with accents, subdivisions, and recorded percussion or an electronic click.
• Practice with tempo ramps, silent bars, and polyrhythms. When it’s time to play live, bring your setlists and saved song tempos.

Free and ad-free. Tuning and basic metronome playback work offline.
whats_new: Tuner is here. Tune guitar, bass, ukulele, bowed strings, banjo, and mandolin string by string, or use Chromatic to check any note. Switch between Tuner and Metronome from the mode menu.
